'''Haesel Palan''' is a rug merchant from [[Murandy]].{{ref/book|c|{{PAGENAME}}||Palan, Haesel}}

==Appearance==
Haesel is a plump woman.

==History==
She stayed at the [[Gates of Heaven]] Inn in [[Canluum]] at the same time as several [[Aes Sedai]], including [[Cadsuane Melaidhrin]], [[Larelle Tarsi]], [[Felaana Bevaine]], and [[Merean Redhill]]. Though not in the company of the others, the newly raised [[Moiraine Damodred]] of the [[Blue Ajah]] also stayed at the inn concurrently with the them while on the [[Tamra Ospenya's Searchers|search]] for the infant [[Dragon Reborn]]. After being questioned publicly by Cadsuane and Felaana, she seemed a [[wilder]] to the innkeeper, who had Moiraine share her room and bed with Haesel Palan.{{Ref/book|0|18}} Moiraine did not enjoy the night; Palan snored and spent half the night talking.{{Ref/book|0|18}}
